answer: The CNIL addresses the articulation between the RGPD and the proposed European AI regulation (RIA) by stating that the RGPD applies independently of the RIA, which has a different scope of application. The CNIL clarifies certain points of articulation, particularly regarding the qualification of actors and the necessity of conducting an Analysis of Impact on Data Protection (AIPD) for systems identified as high-risk under the RIA. It emphasizes that an AIPD would be mandatory for high-risk systems as classified by the RIA.
